# smalljs

> Documentation for $mol — a reactive UI framework with typed views, automatic reactivity, and no virtual DOM. Each page below is available as raw Markdown at the linked URL.

## Getting Started

- [Introduction](https://b-on-g.github.io/smalljs/docs/introduction.md): What $mol is, who it is for, and a taste of reactive views.
- [Getting Started](https://b-on-g.github.io/smalljs/docs/getting-started.md): From an empty folder to a running, reactive $mol app in under 15 minutes.
- [Tooling](https://b-on-g.github.io/smalljs/docs/tooling.md): Project scaffolder, view.tree language server, and editor support for Zed and VS Code.

## Essentials

- [Installation](https://b-on-g.github.io/smalljs/docs/installation.md): The MAM workspace, module layout, dev server, and production build.
- [Views](https://b-on-g.github.io/smalljs/docs/views.md): Declaring and composing components with the view.tree language.
- [State & Reactivity](https://b-on-g.github.io/smalljs/docs/state.md): Reactive properties, actions vs. computations, keyed and async state.
- [Routing](https://b-on-g.github.io/smalljs/docs/routing.md): The URL as reactive state: screens, links, and multiple parameters.
- [Rendering](https://b-on-g.github.io/smalljs/docs/rendering.md): No virtual DOM, lazy components, and virtualized rendering — plus reproducible benchmarks.

## Data

- [Data Fetching](https://b-on-g.github.io/smalljs/docs/data.md): Loading remote data with reactive async properties and loading states.
- [Data Schemas](https://b-on-g.github.io/smalljs/docs/data-schema.md): Runtime typing and validation of backend data with $mol_data and $mol_schema.
- [Giper Baza](https://b-on-g.github.io/smalljs/docs/giper-baza.md): Optional project for local-first data synced between clients via CRDTs: entities, atoms, and CRUD.

## More

- [Showcase](https://b-on-g.github.io/smalljs/docs/showcase.md): Real apps and tools built with $mol, from community platforms to devtools.
- [From React, Vue & Svelte](https://b-on-g.github.io/smalljs/docs/rosetta.md): A concept translation table for developers coming from other frameworks.
- [Cookbook](https://b-on-g.github.io/smalljs/docs/cookbook.md): Copy-ready recipes for common tasks: inputs, lists, fetching, local state, routing, and theming.

## Advanced

- [Plugins](https://b-on-g.github.io/smalljs/docs/plugins.md): Element-less components that attach behaviour (hotkeys, theme, navigation) to a host view.
- [Module metadata](https://b-on-g.github.io/smalljs/docs/meta.md): The meta.tree file: include, deploy, and pack directives for a module.
- [Offline](https://b-on-g.github.io/smalljs/docs/offline.md): Work with no network via a caching service worker: mol/offline/install and installable PWAs.
- [Ghost views](https://b-on-g.github.io/smalljs/docs/ghost.md): Node-less views that borrow another component's DOM element to mix in behaviour.

## About

- [FAQ](https://b-on-g.github.io/smalljs/docs/faq.md): Common questions about $mol and smalljs: readiness, size, learning curve, and getting help.
- [Team](https://b-on-g.github.io/smalljs/docs/team.md): Who builds $mol and how to contribute to the open monorepo.
- [Releases](https://b-on-g.github.io/smalljs/docs/releases.md): How $mol is delivered continuously from the mam_mol monorepo, and how to follow changes.
